mathEnvironment.title: LaTeX Math Environment
mathEnvironment.content:
LaTeX mathematical formulas need to be written in specific environments:

• **Inline Formula**: Use `$...$` to wrap, such as `$x^2$` → $x^2$
• **Display Formula**: Use `$$...$$` to wrap, such as `$$E = mc^2$$` → $$E = mc^2$$

superscriptSubscript.title: Superscripts and Subscripts
superscriptSubscript.content:
• Use `^` for superscripts: `$x^2$` → $x^2$
• Use `_` for subscripts: `$x_1$` → $x_1$
• Use both together: `$x_1^2$` → $x_1^2$

radicals.title: Radicals
radicals.content:
Use `\sqrt{}` command:

• `$\sqrt{x}$` → $\sqrt{x}$ (square root)
• `$\sqrt[3]{x}$` → $\sqrt[3]{x}$ (cube root)
• `$\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$` → $\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$

commonSymbols.title: Common Mathematical Symbols
commonSymbols.content:
• `$\infty$` → $\infty$ (infinity)
• `$\pm$` → $\pm$ (plus-minus)
• `$\times$` → $\times$ (times)
• `$\div$` → $\div$ (division)
• `$\neq$` → $\neq$ (not equal)
• `$\leq$` → $\leq$ (less than or equal)
• `$\geq$` → $\geq$ (greater than or equal)
• `$\approx$` → $\approx$ (approximately equal)
